message:
feat(ledger): add exact registered-node resolution and snapshot integrity checks

Introduce a root-bound resolver with independent raw/projection/span verification,
UTF-8 safe resumable node reads, typed refusals, and imported-snapshot provenance.
Keep converted source generations coherent during Markdown-only reconciliation.
The daemon and MCP adapters are connected in the following integration change.

replacements.before: let (path, revision, raw_hash, generation, lifecycle, sensitivity) = db.lock().query_row(

replacements.after:
"SELECT CASE WHEN length(raw_input)<=8388608 THEN raw_input ELSE NULL END,raw_sha256,
                CASE WHEN length(CAST(markdown AS BLOB))<=8388608 THEN markdown ELSE NULL END,
                markdown_sha256,converter,converter_version,
WHERE repository_root<>?2 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_document_conversions owned_conversion WHERE owned_conversion.doc_id=ledger_doc_artifacts.doc_id)
